title: Wayfare Pass Student Plan — Keeping Student Verification Current
content:
# Keeping student verification current — Wayfare Pass Student

**Rule.** A Wayfare Pass Student membership of Wayfare Pass (rider membership) needs student verification valid on each renewal date. Verification is renewed through Wayfare's verification partner and extends the verification expiry date by the plan's verification validity in calendar months from the verification date. When the verification expiry date has passed and the member has not re-verified within the plan's re-verification grace in calendar days after it, the membership converts at its next renewal to the plan's conversion plan and is charged that plan's fee; it is not cancelled. A member who re-verifies before that renewal stays on the Student plan.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition at the next renewal | Result |
|---|---|
| Verification valid on the renewal date | Stays on Wayfare Pass Student |
| Verification expired, member re-verified before the renewal | Stays on Wayfare Pass Student |
| Verification expired and no re-verification within the grace after expiry | Converts at that renewal to the conversion plan and is charged that plan's fee; not cancelled |

## Hypothetical case

A Student member's verification expiry date has passed, the 14-day re-verification grace after it has run out without re-verification, and the next renewal arrives. At that renewal the membership converts to Wayfare Pass Monthly and is charged the Wayfare Pass Monthly fee. The membership itself continues; it is not cancelled. Had the member re-verified before that renewal, the membership would have stayed on Wayfare Pass Student.
